name: LinearSolve.jl
description: LinearSolve.jl: High-Performance Unified Interface for Linear Solvers in Julia. Easily switch between factorization and Krylov methods, add preconditioners, and all in one interface.

latest_release.name: v5.18.3
latest_release.body:
## LinearSolve v5.18.3

[Diff since v5.18.2](https://github.com/SciML/LinearSolve.jl/compare/v5.18.2...v5.18.3)


**Merged pull requests:**
- Fix PardisoJL matrix-type selection for symmetric sparse systems (#1345) (@ChrisRackauckas-Claude)
- typos: inferrable → inferable in IterativeSolversExt comment (#1346) (@ChrisRackauckas-Claude)
- Default solver: route adjoint solve through QR after the LU-to-QR fallback (#1373) (@ChrisRackauckas-Claude)
- Fix QA: explicit triangular-type imports, drop non-public IterativeSolvers.converged (#1383) (@ChrisRackauckas-Claude)
- Fix QA: resolve a Reactant that loads on Julia 1.13 and take adjoint from Base (#1387) (@ChrisRackauckas)
- Allow JET 0.12 in the QA environment for Julia 1.13 (#1389) (@ChrisRackauckas)
- Mooncake solve! rule: reuse the forward solution in the pullback (#1390) (@AstitvaAggarwal)
- Bump version to 5.18.3 (#1391) (@ChrisRackauckas)
- Cancel superseded PR CI runs (#1392) (@ChrisRackauckas)
- ForwardDiff ext: pass assumptions to the primal init as a keyword only (#1401) (@pankgeorg)

**Closed issues:**
- Default solver: reverse mode after the LU-to-QR fallback uses the failed LU, so `∂b` is NaN or wrong (#1367)
- SupernodalLU errors on in-place sparsity pattern change (#1398)
